title: Data Distillation: Towards Omni-Supervised Learning
mechanism: Omni-supervised learning: all labelled data plus unlabelled data. Labels for the unlabelled data come from ensembling one model's predictions over multiple input transforms, and a student is retrained on the union.
adaptation: Single-model teacher = one PF model with 8-way dihedral TTA (rot90 x flip; EL cracks have no orientation prior), applied to the 11.9k pool. A cheaper alternative to a 5-seed ensemble teacher and easy to refresh for later rounds.
min_experiment: Same as the ensemble-distillation arm B, but with a single-model TTA teacher. Baseline: PF single model. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: no gain >= +0.008 crack IoU over PF and no E1 gain.
evidence: R: CVPR 2018, keypoint and box detection on COCO, with gains over the fully supervised baseline when internet-scale unlabelled images are added (numbers not retrieved).
prior_overlap: Partial. The SSL row used an online EMA teacher without TTA ensembling. Offline TTA teacher labels have not been tested.
